summary: Build an app to store and manage a simple personal database with fields: name, mobile number, date of birth, education, height, weight, hobby, city, and a final image.
architectural_notes: Decide whether to store height internally in inches or store a canonical unit (e.g., cm) and convert for display; keep validation consistent with the chosen unit.

existing_features.title: Build a frontend form to create and edit records with inputs for: name, mobile number, date of birth, education, height, weight, hobby, city, and an image upload control.
Create a frontend records list view that displays stored records and allows selecting a record to view details, edit it, or delete it.
Wire the frontend to the backend using React Query for fetching and mutations (create/update/delete), including optimistic or refetch-based consistency so the list updates after changes.

Apply a coherent, creative visual theme across the app (colors, typography, spacing, and components) suitable for a simple personal database UI; keep it consistent across the form, list, and detail views.
Update the UI to use inches for the height field instead of centimeters, including the height input label in the record create/edit form and the height unit displayed in the record detail view.
Update frontend validation for the height field to validate inches (not centimeters), including updating the allowed numeric range and the validation error message to reference inches.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a database-style app to capture and store records with fields: name, mobile number, date of birth, education, height, weight, hobby, city, and an image.

Create a data model for a personal record with the following fields: name, mobile number, date of birth, education, height, weight, hobby, city, and an image; persist records in the Motoko canister so they remain available after refresh/redeploy.
Implement CRUD canister methods for the personal records database: create a record, list all records, get a record by id, update a record, and delete a record.

Add backend validation for record fields: require name and mobile number; validate mobile number is numeric and within a reasonable length; validate height and weight are numeric; validate date of birth is a valid date; reject images above a reasonable maximum size.
Change the height field to use inches instead of centimeters (update UI label/input expectations and any stored data/validation accordingly).
Update backend validation for the height field to treat the stored height value as inches, including updating the allowed numeric range and the trap error message to reference inches.

projectName: Personal Records Database App (Form + Image Upload + CRUD)
